name: Scouting Wave
text: Tonight, a once-in-a-lifetime metor shower descends from the heavens. Some look up at the night sky and marvel, while others recoil and warn others of impending doom. The fearmongers overcome the population, and many fear that this nightime display is a sign of the future. You can't help but wonder though...

name: Probing Wave
text: Tonight, a once-in-a-lifetime metor shower descends from the heavens. While some look up at the night sky and marvel, others recall attacks from unholy forces. A meteor shower like this one has happened before, so whatever happens, you feel prepared for what comes next.

choices.text: But can we really be sure?

name: Invasion Wave
text: No meteor shower can outpreform the warning that is a rumbling upon the earth.

choices.text: We must end them, here and now!

name: Uprising
text: A revolt has broken out! Some of those among them seem to be making a racket, as if to call down the enemy from above!

uniques: Rebel units may spawn <with [100]% chance> <for [10] turns>
